attchmntText: Khaitan Chemicals & Fertilizers Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Khaitan Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited filed the newspaper cuttings of its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The results were published in the Free Press English edition and the Choutha Sansar Hindi edition on November 14, 2026. The filing was submitted to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited pursuant to SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations. The document was signed by Company Secretary Sejal Maheshwari.

attchmntText: Khaitan Chemicals & Fertilizers Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Khaitan Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited informed the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited that its Board of Directors reviewed fines of Rs. 11800 each, including GST, imposed by both exchanges. The penalties were levied for non-compliance with Regulation 29(2) and 29(3) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Regulations, 2015. The violation stemmed from a one-day delay in furnishing prior intimation about the Board meeting for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The Board noted the delay was unintentional and procedural, occurring while the company expedited financial result declarations during an external credit rating review. The company confirmed that the fines were received on August 14, 2026, and have been duly paid. The Board acknowledged the lapse, strengthened internal compliance mechanisms to prevent recurrence, and directed management to ensure strict adherence to regulatory timelines. The company stated there is no material impact on its financials or operations.

attchmntText: Khaitan Chemicals & Fertilizers Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Khaitan Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited announced the outcome of its Board of Directors meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board approved the unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. An independent auditors’ report on these results was issued with an unmodified opinion. The meeting commenced at 11.15 A.M. and concluded at 01.00 P.M. This information has been uploaded to the company website at http://www.kcfl.co.in. The NSE symbol is KHAICHEM and the BSE scrip code is 507794. The communication was signed by Sejal Maheshwari, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.
